  def initialize(min_rating:, category_id: nil)
    @min_rating = min_rating
    @category_id = category_id

    scope = Product
      .joins("LEFT JOIN reviews ON reviews.product_id = products.id AND reviews.rating >= #{@min_rating}")
      .group("products.id")
      .select("products.*, COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count")

  end

module Checkout
  class PlaceOrder
    def initialize(cart:, payment_method_id:)
      @cart = cart
      @payment_method_id = payment_method_id
    end

    def call
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        order = Order.create!(user: @cart.user, total_cents: @cart.total_cents, status: "pending")
        @cart.items.each { |item| order.line_items.create!(product_id: item.product_id, quantity: item.quantity) }
        charge = Stripe::PaymentIntent.create(

          currency: "usd",
          customer: @cart.user.stripe_customer_id,
          payment_method: @payment_method_id,
          confirm: true
        )
        order.update!(status: "paid", stripe_payment_intent_id: charge.id)
        order
      end
    end
  end
end

class Event < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :calendar
  has_many :attendees, dependent: :destroy

  validates :title, presence: true, length: { maximum: 120 }
  validates :starts_at, :ends_at, presence: true
  validate :ends_after_start

  scope :upcoming, -> { where("starts_at >= ?", Time.current).order(:starts_at) }

  def duration
    ends_at - starts_at
  end

  private

  def ends_after_start
    return if starts_at.blank? || ends_at.blank?

    errors.add(:ends_at, "must be after the start time") if ends_at <= starts_at
  end
end
